reference_comparison.reference_vessel: KVLCC2 MARIN L7, single screw/single rudder, model scale

measured_input_replay.rudder: MARIN measured actual rudder angle, replayed samplewise with the documented sign inversion and no rate limiter
measured_input_replay.identity_result: all six runs have rudder replay RMSE below 1e-12 deg and propeller replay RMSE of zero

where_divergence_occurs.early_heading_window: all six runs pass the active 300 s, 15 deg bounded-heading criterion
scalar_failures: turning-circle advance: 6.46% and 8.33% error against a 5% tolerance
turning-circle tactical diameter: one direction is 8.00% error against a 5% tolerance
zig-zag overshoots: failures occur in every run, ranging from 10.57% to 212.86% error
where_divergence_occurs.full_track: full-track position and heading divergence is retained as diagnostic-only because the reference hull is course-unstable

allocation_authority_assessment.reason: The failing MARIN scorer uses MmgPlanarSimulator with measured propeller/rudder inputs; it does not call VehicleBMmgForceModel.resolveCommand, a controller, or a wrench allocator. Saturation frequency and requested-versus-applied force histories therefore do not exist for this comparison and cannot cause its failure.

production_command_mapping_review.finding: The production mapper independently clamps surge and yaw before mapping them to propeller RPM and rudder angle. This is a potential production-control envelope limitation (rudder authority depends on propeller inflow), but it was bypassed by the MARIN replay and is not evidenced as the source of the MARIN failure.

diagnosis.classification: model/reference parameterization mismatch, not demonstrated authority/allocation saturation
diagnosis.likely_scale: larger than a bounded allocator correction
evidence: Measured actuator channels are reproduced exactly while maneuver indices still fail.
The strongest errors are zig-zag overshoots, including asymmetric port/starboard behavior, which point to MMG hull/rudder/interaction dynamics rather than command clipping.
The MARIN KVLCC2 coefficients are explicitly not transferred to the independently unvalidated Vehicle B USV production parameter set.
diagnosis.next_review_decision: Do not change Vehicle B allocation or hydrodynamic parameters from this diagnosis. Decide whether to fund a bounded KVLCC2 model-structure identification/reproduction effort and, separately, acquire independent Vehicle B captive/free-running data for USV-scale validation.

evidence_boundary: A KVLCC2 result can support MMG model-structure evidence only; it cannot validate the Vehicle B USV coefficients.
